name: Pixieset

pricing.free_plan: Free forever: website with 15 pages and 100 photos, galleries with 3 GB, 15% commission on store sales.

tiers.name: Website Free
tiers.note: 15 pages, 100 photos, 5 blog posts, Pixieset banner

tiers.name: Website Plus
tiers.note: billed annually, 15 monthly; custom domain, unlimited photos, no banner

tiers.name: Website Pro
tiers.note: billed annually, 24 monthly; custom code, advanced theming

capabilities: Free plan publishes a real website, not a preview
Client galleries with downloads and proofing in the same account
Store for prints and downloads, commission-free on paid plans
limits: Free website is capped at 100 photos — quickly reached by a portfolio
Custom domain needs the 12 USD plan
The photography workflow is separate from the website plans
summary: Free portfolio website plus client galleries; the closest thing to a photographer's toolkit.
